# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.73

## Added

- Added current-driver evolution to RX Workflow Tracking using the existing
  Pharmacy Transportation assignment. Newly completed stages capture the
  current driver, historical corrections affect only the selected stage, and
  later stages continue from the latest current assignment.
- Added four granular RX permissions for viewing driver history, assigning the
  current driver, correcting completed-stage drivers, and synchronizing the
  complete driver history.
- Added Pending, Reviewed, and All states to Backoffice RX Profile Sync. Exact
  Pharmacy and Transport differences can be marked reviewed without changing
  RX data, reopened later, and automatically return to Pending when either
  compared value changes.

## Audit and safety

- Driver assignment, stage snapshots, corrections, synchronization, undo, and
  warehouse reset use transactional locking and an append-only ledger.
- RX Profile Sync review and reopen events are append-only and included in the
  activity export. Driver history remains redacted when the dedicated permission
  is absent, and affected CSV exports neutralize spreadsheet formulas.
- Existing completed stages are not rewritten by a current-driver change.
  Whole-RX synchronization remains a separately permissioned recovery action.

## Database

- Adds audited migrations `20260818000000-add-rx-driver-tracking` and
  `20260818120000-add-rx-profile-sync-review-events`.
- Both migrations are transactional and checksum-registered. The release
  updater applies and verifies them while the application is stopped; no
  workflow-action configuration or existing completed-stage history is
  reseeded.

## Validation

- Passed sanitized production-copy staging tests, dedicated PostgreSQL driver
  and review regressions, permission and audit-redaction coverage, sanitizer
  validation, report/dashboard checks, and the complete isolated Chrome suite.
- Staging and development operator testing passed before production release
  preparation.
